    fn build_field_index_policies_attribute() -> AttributeSchema {
        AttributeSchema::optional("field_index_policies", AttributeType::refined_list(crate::schemas::awscc_types::logs_field_index_policy(), false, Some((Some(1), Some(3))), carina_core::schema::ListElements::Unique))
                .with_provider_name("FieldIndexPolicies")
                .with_default(Value::Concrete(ConcreteValue::List(vec![])))
                .with_block_name("field_index_policy")
            .build()
    }
